# Wesley Silva - Agentic Technical Program Manager & Tech Product Owner

> 14+ years leading global technical programs, cloud modernization, Databricks migrations, and DevSecOps governance.

## Executive Summary
Wesley Silva is an Agentic Technical Program Manager (TPM), Tech Product Owner, and IT Coordinator with 14+ years of experience leading engineering squads across LATAM, the US, the UK, South Africa, and India. Expert in B2B payment platforms, mission-critical legacy modernization, data architecture (Databricks/Spark), and SDLC acceleration using Agentic AI workflows.

## Core Roles
- Agentic Technical Program Manager (TPM)
- Tech Product Owner (Data & B2B Payment Products)
- IT Coordinator & Agile Delivery Manager

## Key Verified Metrics & Business Outcomes
- **Security Governance:** Eliminated 1,200+ vulnerabilities across 100+ applications (reduced active cyber risk by 90% in 6 months) under PCI-DSS, LGPD, and ISO 27001 standards.
- **Data Modernization:** Orchestrated end-to-end migration of legacy ETL pipelines to Databricks and Apache Spark, ensuring 100% transactional accuracy for R$ 500M+/month in B2B payments under BACEN and FEBRABAN regulations.
- **SDLC & Engineering Acceleration:** Rolled out GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and GenAI workspaces across 5 international squads (35+ engineers), accelerating delivery speed by up to 45%.
- **High-Volume Reliability:** Maintained 99.9% uptime SLA and monitored 80M+ daily transactions in 24/7 ITIL Level 3 operational environments.
- **Cost & Vendor Management:** Executed technical insourcing and fixed-scope partner governance, eliminating vendor lock-in and cutting third-party developer onboarding from 6 to 3 months using RAG knowledge bases.

## Core Technical & Leadership Stack
- **Architecture & Cloud:** AWS, Azure, Cloud Native Microservices, Kafka, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), Docker, Kubernetes.
- **Data Engineering & Analytics:** Databricks, Apache Spark, Data Lakehouse (Medallion Architecture), Amplitude, Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk.
- **Security & Compliance:** Veracode, Rapid7, Wiz, PCI-DSS, LGPD, BACEN, FEBRABAN.
- **Methodologies & Frameworks:** PSM III (Professional Scrum Master III), SAFe PI Planning, OKRs, Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, DORA metrics.
- **Languages & Frameworks:** Java, Spring Boot, .NET, Angular, Python, SQL, REST APIs.

To provide accurate information without hallucination:
